A venue not ACTIVE or whose account is disabled is VENUE_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_NEW_ACTIVITY; an unknown venue or a room of another venue is NOT_FOUND. The venue cost is fixed now: the hourly price of each room x the duration, half-up to 2 decimals per room, summed (FR-TRN-28); entryFee and prize are informational (FR-TRN-29), 0.00 when absent. approvalExpiresAt = MIN(createdAt + 10 minutes, checkpointAt) (FR-TRN-10). A CONFIRMED booking whose start has not been processed yet is judged as its start would have been at startAt, the same way for check-in, Mark Present — Late and no-show. If the start would succeed, the booking is started first exactly as the start would have started it - ACTIVE from startAt - and the action is then recorded as above, in the same request.
